# Ignisign

IgniSign is a comprehensive electronic signature platform that enables users to sign, send, and manage documents securely online.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ignisign/.

## Actions

- **Cancel Signature Request**: Cancel a signature request.
- **Close Ignisign Signature Request**: Close an active signature request.
- **Create Signer**: Create a new signer.
- **Create Webhook Endpoint**: Create a new webhook endpoint for an application.
- **Get application context** (read-only): Retrieve the global context of an application.
- **Get Document Information** (read-only): Retrieve document metadata by ID.
- **Get Missing Signer Inputs** (read-only): Determine missing inputs needed for a signer in a specific signature profile.
- **Get Signature Request Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information for a specific signature request.
- **Get Signature Request Document** (read-only): Retrieve the document associated with a specific signature request.
- **Get Signature Request Status** (read-only): Retrieve the current status of a specific signature request.
- **Get Signature Requests** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of signature requests for an application.
- **Get Signed Document** (read-only): Download the signed document (signature proof) for a signature request.
- **Get Signer Creation Constraints** (read-only): Retrieve input constraints required to create a signer for a specific signature profile.
- **Get Signer Input Constraints** (read-only): Get signer input constraints.
- **Get Signer Inputs** (read-only): Retrieve inputs provided by a signer for a signature request.
- **Get Signer Profile** (read-only): Retrieve a signer profile.
- **Get Signer Profiles** (read-only): Retrieve signer profiles.
- **Get Webhook Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific webhook endpoint.
- **Get Webhooks** (read-only): List all webhook endpoints configured for an application environment.
- **Ignisign API Authentication**: Authenticate an application over Ignisign API and retrieve a JWT.
- **Initialize Document**: Initialize a document for a signature request.
- **Initialize Ignisign Signature Request**: Initialize a new signature request.
- **List Documents** (read-only): Retrieve documents linked to a signature request.
- **Provide Document Content Data JSON**: Provide JSON content for a document.
- **Provide Document Content File**: Provide file content for a document.
- **Provide Document Content Private File**: Provide private content for a document via its SHA-256 hash.
- **Publish Signature Request**: Publish a draft signature request.
- **Search Signers** (read-only): Search for signers within an application.
- **Update Document Information**: Update document metadata.
- **Update Signature Request**: Partially update a signature request in DRAFT state.
- **Update Signer**: Update details of an existing signer.
- **Update Webhook Endpoint**: Update an existing webhook endpoint.
- **Delete Document**: Delete a specific document by its ID.
- **Delete Ignisign Signature Request**: Delete a signature request.
- **Delete Signer**: Delete a signer.
- **Delete Webhook Endpoint**: Delete a specific webhook endpoint.
